required.quote: Beginning May 1, 1976, all registered podiatrists then or thereafter licensed in the State of North Carolina shall be required to take annual courses of study in subjects relating to the practice of the profession of podiatry

hours_per_period.quote: The length of study shall be prescribed by the Board but shall not exceed 25 hours in any calendar year

requirements.value: applicant must be currently an active, competent practitioner in good standing; have practiced at least five years immediately preceding application with at least three of those five years in a state that grants similar reciprocity to North Carolina podiatrists; currently hold a valid license in another state; have no disciplinary proceeding or unresolved complaint pending; and licensure requirements in the other state must be equivalent to or higher than those required by North Carolina
requirements.quote: the applicant is currently an active, competent practitioner in good standing; and the applicant has practiced at least five years immediately preceding his or her application with at least three of those five years being in a state that grants similar reciprocity to North Carolina podiatrists; and the applicant currently holds a valid license in another state; and No disciplinary proceeding or unresolved complaint is pending anywhere at the time a license is to be issued by this State; and The licensure requirements in the other state are equivalent to or higher than those required by this State, and the licensure requirements of that other state grant similar reciprocity to podiatrists licensed in North Carolina

is_mandatory.quote: if any person shall practice podiatry without being duly licensed and registered, as provided in this Article, he shall not be allowed to maintain any action to collect any fee for such services. Any person who engages in the practice of podiatry unless licensed and registered as hereinabove defined, or who attempts to do so, or who professes to do so, shall be guilty of a Class 1 misdemeanor

title_protection.quote: Any person who engages in the practice of podiatry unless licensed and registered as hereinabove defined, or who attempts to do so, or who professes to do so, shall be guilty of a Class 1 misdemeanor

scope_protection.quote: No person shall practice podiatry unless he shall have been first licensed and registered so to do in the manner provided in this Article

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in fraud, deceit or misrepresentation in obtaining or attempting to obtain a license or renewal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in any act or acts of fraud, deceit or misrepresentation in obtaining or attempting to obtain a license or the renewal thereof

disciplinary_grounds.description: Chronic or persistent user of alcohol intoxicants or habit-forming drugs or narcotics impairing ability to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is a chronic or persistent user of alcohol intoxicants or habit-forming drugs or narcotics to the extent that the same impairs his ability to practice podiatry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of criminal provisions of the podiatry article or entered plea of guilty or nolo contendere
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of any of the criminal provisions of this Article or has entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to any charge or charges arising therefrom

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of felony or misdemeanor involving moral turpitude or entered plea of guilty or nolo contendere
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of or entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to any felony charge or to any misdemeanor charge involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of violation of state or federal narcotic or barbiturate law or entered plea of guilty or nolo contendere
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of or entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to any charge of violation of any state or federal narcotic or barbiturate law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in act or practice violative of article provisions or rules, or aided, abetted or assisted violation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in any act or practice violative of any of the provisions of this Article or violative of any of the rules and regulations promulgated and adopted by the Board, or has aided, abetted or assisted any other person or entity in the violation of the same

disciplinary_grounds.description: Mentally, emotionally, or physically unfit to practice or afflicted with disability dangerous to patient health and welfare
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is mentally, emotionally, or physically unfit to practice podiatry or is afflicted with such a physical or mental disability as to be deemed dangerous to the health and welfare of his patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertised services in false, deceptive, or misleading manner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has advertised services in a false, deceptive, or misleading manner

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitted use of name, diploma or license by another person in illegal practice or fraudulent licensure attempt
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has permitted the use of his name, diploma or license by another person either in the illegal practice of podiatry or in attempting to fraudulently obtain a license to practice podiatry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in immoral conduct discrediting the podiatry profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in such immoral conduct as to discredit the podiatry profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtained, collected or attempted to obtain or collect fee through fraud, misrepresentation, or deceit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has obtained or collected or attempted to obtain or collect any fee through fraud, misrepresentation, or deceit

disciplinary_grounds.description: Negligent in the practice of podiatry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been negligent in the practice of podiatry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Not professionally competent in the practice of podiatry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is not professionally competent in the practice of podiatry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practiced fraud, deceit or misrepresentation upon public or individual to acquire or retain patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has practiced any fraud, deceit or misrepresentation upon the public or upon any individual in an effort to acquire or retain any patient or patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Made fraudulent or misleading statements pertaining to skill, knowledge, or method of treatment or practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has made fraudulent or misleading statements pertaining to his skill, knowledge, or method of treatment or practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committed fraudulent or misleading acts in the practice of podiatry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has committed any fraudulent or misleading acts in the practice of podiatry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Wrongfully, fraudulently or falsely held self out as qualified specialist in branch of podiatry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has wrongfully or fraudulently or falsely held himself out to be or represented himself to be qualified as a specialist in any branch of podiatry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Persistently maintained unsanitary offices, practices, or techniques
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has persistently maintained, in the practice of podiatry, unsanitary offices, practices, or techniques

disciplinary_grounds.description: Menace to public health by reason of serious communicable disease
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is a menace to the public health by reason of having a serious communicable disease

disciplinary_grounds.description: Distributed or caused distribution of intoxicant, drug, or narcotic for other than lawful purpose
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has distributed or caused to be distributed any intoxicant, drug, or narcotic for any other than a lawful purpose

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in unprofessional conduct as defined by board rules and regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in any unprofessional conduct as the same may be, from time to time, defined by the rules and regulations of the Board

definition_quote.value: Podiatry as defined by this Article is the surgical, medical, or mechanical treatment of all ailments of the human foot and ankle, and their related soft tissue structures to the level of the myotendinous junction
definition_quote.quote: Podiatry as defined by this Article is the surgical, medical, or mechanical treatment of all ailments of the human foot and ankle, and their related soft tissue structures to the level of the myotendinous junction

methods_authorized.quote: the surgical, medical, or mechanical treatment of all ailments of the human foot and ankle

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: the surgical, medical, or mechanical treatment of all ailments of the human foot and ankle, and their related soft tissue structures to the level of the myotendinous junction

amputation_authorized.quote: Excluded from the definition of podiatry is the amputation of the entire foot

anesthesia_authority.quote: Excluded from the definition of podiatry is the amputation of the entire foot, the administration of an anesthetic other than local

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: Except for procedures for bone spurs and simple soft tissue procedures, any surgery on the ankle or on the soft tissue structures related to the ankle

ankle_surgery_residency_requirement.quote: The North Carolina Board of Podiatry Examiners shall maintain a list of podiatrists qualified to perform the surgeries listed in subsection (b) of this section, along with specific information on the surgical training successfully completed by each licensee

ankle_surgery_facility_requirement.quote: any surgery on the ankle or on the soft tissue structures related to the ankle, any amputations, and any surgical correction of clubfoot shall be performed by a podiatrist only in a hospital licensed under Article 5 of Chapter 131E of the General Statutes or in a multispecialty ambulatory surgical facility that is not a licensed office setting, and that is licensed under Part D of Article 6 of Chapter 131E of the General Statutes

clubfoot_surgery_restriction.quote: Excluded from the definition of podiatry is the amputation of the entire foot, the administration of an anesthetic other than local, and the surgical correction of clubfoot of an infant two years of age or less
